summary: This directory is dedicated to the testing of markdown rendering logic. Its primary purpose is to verify that document content is correctly transformed and output as expected during the rendering process.
responsibilities: Verify the correctness of markdown rendering outputs
Validate document formatting and transformation logic
Ensure consistent rendering behavior through automated tests
relationships: Test suites validate the output produced by the markdown rendering components.
The rendering process is verified against expected document transformations.
designDecisions: Collocation of test files with their corresponding rendering logic
Utilization of automated test assertions for content verification
